title: Walking up to an NPC with nothing to offer shows no prompt; walking up to WC-RAV-NPC06 with the sample greeter on offers its service, X or a click routes it, and walking away takes it away, once per crossing
notes: 7.07: an NPC shows a prompt only when it has something to offer. The game master first walks up to WC-GTW-Registrar, template 39088, which no
script serves: no MSG_SENDNPCOPTIONS, no prompt, no MSG_LEAVESERVICERANGE. Npc.TestGreeter turns on the spec's sample npc_test_greeter for
this run only; in play it is off, and real prompts come from the quest givers of 7.08 and 7.09 and the shops of phase 8.
Each NPC is reached with go_to_npc, 290 units off, inside its range, and facing it. The game master is then put by WC-RAV-NPC06, template 38232, and takes a step, which brings it into the NPC's
300-unit range: the game server sends MSG_SENDNPCOPTIONS with the sample npc_test_greeter's one option, and the client shows the NPC's prompt
with its name and portrait, and pressing X, as the prompt asks, sends MSG_INTERACTOPTION, which the server routes as option 0 to npc_test_greeter.
Steps inside the range offer nothing more; put far away, a step takes the wizard out of range with MSG_LEAVESERVICERANGE.
The far point faces yaw 3.1416, into Ravenwood and away from the Commons door, as this client walks along (-sin yaw, -cos yaw).
